name: Where Is Fahd?
desc:
Where Is Fahd? 🔦 | وين فهد؟
Where Is Fahd is a story adventure in 12 parts, set in a Gulf neighborhood and the desert around it.
Fahd, an 8-year-old boy, vanished one night. His father has only two days… so where is Fahd? You are his last hope.

In Where Is Fahd you:
• Play solo or with your friends
• Follow a full story with Arabic voice acting, choices and cinematic scenes
• Search houses, follow tracks, sneak past masked men in the dark
• Find the hidden tapes 📼 and uncover a 20-year-old secret

Every part of Where Is Fahd brings you closer to the truth… and to the whistle in the night.
وين فهد؟ قصة عربية كاملة من ١٢ بارت – العب الحين واعرف وين فهد!
